credit.notes: Lost/stolen: request a replacement via your Online Account (card-replacement path linked from the FAQ) or call Customer Care. Toll-free 1800 419 2122 works from any landline or mobile anywhere in India (general Card Account line; also the Platinum Travel product line). Chargeable 0124 line: 0124 670 2929 — from outside India, replace the 0 of 0124 numbers with +91 (e.g. +91 124 670 2929). Product-specific lines: Platinum Reserve 1800 419 1030, Membership Rewards 1800 419 0167, SmartEarn 1800 208 1226, Gold 1800 419 1120, Platinum 1800 419 1255. Phone hours are not published on the contact page; Mobile Messaging (Chat icon in the Amex App) is stated 24X7, and the app offers 'Temp Block your card' for a misplaced card. Amex India issues credit and charge cards only — no debit cards.
